wizard.title: Bindery — Import PDF
wizard.pickFileHint: The file stays in your browser's memory. It is never uploaded to the Foundry server.
wizard.qualityNoText: No text layer detected (likely a scan)
wizard.errorEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Bindery does not bypass protections and cannot process this file.
wizard.errorGeneric: Could not read this file as a PDF.
wizard.reviewHint: Build a full preview of everything in this document — images, scenes and journals. Nothing is created until you review and confirm.
wizard.journalBuildErrorGeneric: Could not build a preview from this document. See console for details.
wizard.reviewImportDone: Import complete — check the Scenes and Journal sidebars.
wizard.actorProfileHint: Load a profile file so the module can recognize NPC/monster stat blocks in this PDF. Without a profile, import still works normally for maps, images, and journals — the Actors tab will simply be empty.
wizard.actorProfileR3Notice: Profiles for commercial rulebooks are supplied by the user or the community — this module does not include or host them.
wizard.actorProfileErrorNotJson: This file is not valid JSON.
wizard.dropHint: or drop it here — no file selected
wizard.actorProfileHintShort: Import still works without a profile — the Actors tab will simply be empty.
wizard.actorProfileStaleHint: This profile is remembered from when you picked the file — if you edited it since (e.g. in Profile Studio), click "Change profile" and pick it again to load the latest version.

studio.title: Bindery — Profile Studio
studio.hint: Build a profile by pointing at things right on the PDF page — or load an existing one to see what it finds, and fix it up.
studio.metadataStepHint: Before you start building patterns, fill in the profile's basic details — these fields are saved to the file and are required by it.
studio.profileErrorNotJson: This file is not valid JSON.
studio.errorOpenPdf: Could not open this file as a PDF.
studio.errorAnalyze: Analysis failed. See console for details.
studio.noPdfYet: Load a PDF file to see the page preview.
studio.noAnalysisYet: Click "Check all pages" to see results across the whole document.
studio.routeMismatch: This page is route "{pageRoute}", but you're editing route "{activeRoute}" — switch route or go to another page.
studio.routeUnsupported: This page matches the "Player characters" route, but the profile has no patterns for it yet — the filter worked, not a bug.
studio.routeUnsupportedSkipped: route has no patterns in this profile, skipped — the filter worked, not a bug
studio.noEntitiesOnPage: The profile found nothing on this page.
studio.attachClaimedByOther: within range, but claimed by another entity
studio.zeroMatchPatterns: Patterns with zero matches across the whole book (check the regex)
studio.suspiciousMatchCountHint: This matches far more often than there are entities — the pattern is probably too loose, not doing well.
studio.guidanceNoDraft: Start a new profile, or edit the one already loaded.
studio.guidanceAmbiguousValue: More than one possible value nearby — click the highlighted one.
studio.guidanceDraggingBoundary: Drag the bottom edge to where this section should end.
studio.guidanceGridEmpty: Click a characteristic label — e.g. S or STR.
studio.guidanceDerivedEmpty: Click a derived-stat label — e.g. HP or Move.
studio.guidanceHasRows: Click another one, or drag a box around the whole block at once.
studio.guidanceAttacksEmpty: Click the attack section's header — e.g. ATTACKS.
studio.guidanceSkillsEmpty: Click the skills section's header — e.g. SKILLS.
studio.guidanceNotesEmpty: Click "+ Add note block", then point at the token in the PDF where the text should start.
studio.guidanceNotesPicking: Click the token in the PDF where this note block should start.
studio.guidanceNotesHasBlocks: Click "Pick example" on a block to change its position, or add another one.
studio.guidanceName: Click the creature's name in the statblock.
studio.guidanceTypeLabel: Click the creature's occupation or type — e.g. "yacht captain" or "Ghoul".
studio.guidanceNameNoFontKey: Note: this pattern has no specific font style set yet — matching by style alone can be ambiguous (it may hit a nearby label instead of the real name). Click directly on an example name on this page to pin it down.
studio.guidanceTypeLabelNoFontKey: Note: this pattern has no specific font style set yet — matching by style alone can be ambiguous. Click directly on an example occupation/type on this page to pin it down.
studio.guidanceSectionPicked: Click the first element that no longer belongs to this section (or drag the bottom edge).
studio.guidanceItemPatternExamples: Click 2–3 example items in this section — the tool will figure out the shape.
studio.guidanceComplete: Ready to check the whole document.
studio.buildSectionNoBoundary: No boundary set yet — drag the bottom edge on the page.
studio.buildSectionBoundarySuspicious: This boundary is only one or two characters long — it will match all over the book by accident. Click the whole item that starts the next section, or drag the edge again.
studio.buildSectionBoundaryWrongColumn: This boundary lands in a different column than the section header — the section probably swallowed text from the next column. Click the actual next item in the same column, or drag the edge again.
studio.buildSectionBoundaryTooSpecific: This boundary doesn't occur on any other page of the document — it may be too specific to this one character (e.g. their own sub-heading) instead of a shared heading that repeats after every character (e.g. "Skills:"). For other characters, the section may not stop at all.
studio.buildValueTooSpecific: This value doesn't occur on any other page of the document — it may be too specific to this one character/page instead of something shared across the whole publication. If the book only has one entry of this kind, that's fine — otherwise it's worth checking against another character.
studio.buildSectionNeedsItemPattern: Still needs itemPattern (one item's shape) under Advanced settings.
studio.skillsPatternAutoNote: This pattern is flagged as the skills list (skillsPattern) — attached to entities differently than Attacks.
studio.notesNotMeasuredYet: No example picked yet — click "Pick example".
studio.notesPreviewNoEntities: No entity found on this page.
studio.notesLooksTruncatedHint: Note: the text found is basically just the header — if the PDF has more content after it (e.g. smaller subheadings inside the block), check "stopAtSameFontRole" under Advanced so the block flies past them instead of stopping right away.
studio.notesPickFailedInvalidProfile: Can't measure yet — the profile has a validation error elsewhere. Check the "Check" tab.
studio.notesPickFailedMissingMetadata: Can't measure yet — fill in the profile metadata (id, title, game line, language, publication) in the "Metadata and page range" section above the tabs.
studio.notesPickFailedNoAnchor: Can't measure yet — set up the characteristics grid (anchor) first, on the Characteristics tab.
studio.notesPickFailedNoGridOnPage: No matching characteristics grid found on this page — go to a page with an entity and try again.
studio.notesPickFailedNoToken: Couldn't find that token — try clicking again.
studio.nameClickExcludedRole: The text you clicked has style "{role}", which this pattern always excludes (Advanced settings → Excluded roles) — this match will never work. Click a different example with a different style, or adjust the excluded roles.
studio.nameClickLooksLikeLabel: The text you clicked, "{text}", looks like a field LABEL (it ends with a colon, or is already used as a label elsewhere in this profile) rather than a standalone heading. If other field labels in this book (e.g. "Age:") share the same style, this match may pick one of those instead.
studio.itemExampleTokenNotFound: Couldn't find that token on the page — try clicking again.
studio.itemExampleEmptyRowText: Couldn't read any text from that row — try clicking a different part of the entry.
studio.itemExampleAcceptedNoShapeYet: Example accepted ({count}), but no known shape matches it yet — try clicking another example.
studio.notesChainFromPrevious: Measure position relative to the end of the PREVIOUS note block (instead of a fixed point) — enable when note fields on the page follow one after another and the gap between them varies with the length of the text above (e.g. different biography lengths per character).
studio.notesStopAtSameFontRole: Keep collecting until the NEXT heading with the same style as the clicked example (skipping over smaller sub-headings along the way) — instead of stopping at the first sub-heading encountered. Use this when you want one block to catch several fields at once (e.g. a whole character description up to the next major section).
studio.notesAnchorGridOnly: Measure position relative to the characteristics grid only — ignoring Attacks/Skills. Enable for fields in a separate column that's independent of the skills list length (otherwise the position "drifts" between characters with different numbers of skills).
studio.editorRawJsonInvalid: This text is not valid JSON.
studio.rawJsonHint: Full profile as JSON — for fields outside the form (fingerprint.keywords, pages.excludeZones, images). Changes here overwrite the form when you go back.
studio.fieldTreatFullBleedAsContent: Treat full-bleed background images as content
studio.fieldTreatFullBleedAsContentHint: By default, an image covering the whole page with body text drawn on top is assumed to be a repeated page background and is hidden from review. Enable this if this book instead gives every page unique bespoke art — those images will show up as content, and export using only the text-free version when possible.
studio.fieldAutoCropUniformMargins: Experimental: auto-crop blank margins around the illustration
studio.fieldAutoCropUniformMarginsHint: Only applies to images revealed by the option above. Some books flatten the whole page (illustration, blank paper, decorative frame) into a single picture, with no separate image to extract just the illustration. This tries to detect and crop away plain, uniform-colored margins by analyzing pixels — it is a best-effort guess, not exact: pages that are illustrated edge-to-edge are deliberately left uncropped, and results can occasionally be wrong. Check the exported images afterward.
studio.fieldBrightenAutoCroppedImagesHint: Only applies to images actually cropped by the option above. Once the bright page margin is cut away, the illustration can look darker than in the PDF — that's contrast, not a bug (the pixels themselves don't change without this option). Enable it to gently lift shadows and midtones on cropped images.
studio.fieldRemoveTokenBackgroundDefault: Default background removal on in the token prep panel
studio.fieldRemoveTokenBackgroundDefaultHint: Only sets the starting state of the "remove background" toggle in the "Prepare token" panel (Images tab, "Token" destination) — nothing happens automatically in the background, the user always sees a live preview and can change this before confirming.
studio.pickLabelHint: click a label on the page (e.g. "S", "PW")
studio.pickSectionHeaderHint: click a section header on the page (e.g. "ATTACKS")
studio.pickRangedExampleHint: click an example ranged weapon on the page (e.g. "Firearm (pistol .22)")
studio.rangedKeywordEmpty: Couldn't extract a keyword from that click — try clicking a different entry, or type the word in manually.
studio.fieldExcludeRepeated: exclude text repeated across many pages
studio.regexJsonHint: This looks like it was pasted from a JSON file — replace \\ with \?

itemShape.shapePercentRest: name → percent → (optionally) the rest after a comma
itemShape.shapeMixed: name → percent, OR name → value (no percent)

studio.selectAreaHint: Drag over a part of the page (characteristic grid or derived block) — Studio will propose label-value pairs from what it finds there.
studio.selectionNoPairsFound: No label-value pairs recognized in this area — try a smaller selection around just the labels and values, or click labels one at a time instead.
studio.selectionEmptyArea: No text found in this area — try drawing the box over the actual statblock text.
studio.selectionLowConfidenceHint: Low confidence — the value doesn't look like a number (e.g. dice notation). Double-check this is really a label-value pair.
studio.measureNoData: No pages where both patterns occur together.
studio.measureBadPatterns: The anchor must be labelledPairs, and the measured pattern labelledPairs or sectionList.
studio.measureFailed: Measurement failed. See console for details.
studio.mechanicalHint: Enter a relation between canonical keys that you know from your system (e.g. "hitPoints ≈ (constitution + size) / 10" or "sanity = willpower") — we'll check it against every entity found.
studio.relationWarningLowMatch: low match rate — likely a bad mapping
studio.relationWarningPerfect: perfect match — likely the same field mapped twice
studio.relationErrorUnparseable: relation not recognized — expected "key ≈ expression" or "key = expression"

review.title: Bindery — Review
review.actorsNoProfile: This import had no character profile loaded, so no NPC/monster stat blocks were recognized. Close this screen, load a profile file in the import window ("Character profile" section), and run the import again.
review.thumbnailOpenTitle: Click to preview this image and erase parts of it
review.journalGroupHint: Images with destination "Journal" and the same group name are bundled into one journal with multiple pages — leave empty to keep each image as its own journal.
review.journalsOptInHint: Full book text as journals is optional — nothing here is selected by default. Images from the "Images" tab (including the "Journal" destination) do not depend on this selection.
review.selectModeHint: Drag a rectangle over the page to cut it out as a new image, added below like any other.
review.selectModeCropFailed: Couldn't cut that region — try again.
review.resizeFailed: Couldn't resize that image — try again.
review.imageRotateFailed: Couldn't rotate that image — try again.
review.targetHint: Nothing is created until you confirm this screen. Cancel at any point and no documents or files are left behind.
review.actorHint: Statblocks need two passes: parsing never reaches 100% (the input is glyphs from the book, not structured data) — resolve uncertain names, fix values, remove misdetected attacks before importing.
review.actorTokenEmptyHint: No image has destination "Token" — this is optional, the actor will import without a token (Foundry will add its default image). If you want one, set an image's destination in the Images tab.
review.actorSeparatePortraitToggle: Use a different image for the portrait than for the token
review.importErrorGeneric: Import failed. See console for details.
review.footerHintEmpty: Select at least one thing to import (an image, scene, journal, or actor) to continue
review.journalGroupHintShort: Journal images with the same group name land in a single multi-page journal.

gridPicker.title: Set the scene grid
gridPicker.suggestedHint: Grid auto-detected from the image — adjust if needed.
gridPicker.offsetHint: Offset is for preview only — it isn't applied to the created scene. Fine-tune alignment afterwards with Foundry's own "Configure Grid" tool.

imageErase.title: Image preview and erase
imageErase.hint: "View" only lets you inspect the image. Pick an erase tool to remove unwanted parts (for example text captured with the illustration), then apply the changes.

tokenPrep.title: Prepare token
tokenPrep.dragHint: Drag the preview to reposition the crop. The slider below adjusts zoom.
tokenPrep.removeBackgroundAborted: Couldn't safely remove this image's background (not enough contrast between background and content) — the token will be saved without background removal.
tokenPrep.clickToAddHint: Turn on and click a background area that didn't disappear (e.g. the pocket under a hat brim that touches the body) — each click adds another fill with the same tolerance. "Undo" removes the last click. Dragging doesn't move the crop while this is on.
tokenPrep.frameCustomHint: A PNG with transparency, the same square shape as the token — it will be composited on top.
tokenPrep.setDefaultHint: Save the current shape, background removal, frame, size, and format as the starting point for every token you prepare next.
tokenPrep.setDefaultSaved: Saved as the default token setup.

settings.openWizardMenuHint: Open the Bindery PDF import wizard.
settings.openProfileStudioMenuHint: Open the profile tester — check what a profile finds in a PDF before using it to import.
settings.uploadPathHint: Path (in the world's data storage) where images extracted from PDFs are saved.

legal.notice: This tool processes files you own. It does not contain or distribute any publisher's content. Responsibility for holding the rights to imported material rests with you. Import results are not intended for further distribution.

compatibility.stillAvailable: You can still import: maps, handouts, images.
compatibility.bodyLineMismatch: These systems' characteristics aren't translatable — actor and item import has been disabled to avoid creating incorrect data.
compatibility.bodyNoAdapter: This profile doesn't have an adapter for the active world system yet — actor and item import has been disabled.
compatibility.bodyVersionMismatch: The installed system version is too old for this adapter — actor and item import has been disabled.
compatibility.bodyNoTextLayer: This file looks like a scan with no recognized text — statblocks can't be read.
compatibility.actionNoTextLayer: Consider OCR, or import images only

diagnostic.UNICODE_LOW_CONFIDENCE: Text confidence {confidence} — likely corrupted ToUnicode mapping
diagnostic.COLUMN_VALLEY_REJECTED_VERTICAL: {count} column-gap candidate(s) rejected by vertical validation (empty area < {minPercent}% of block height) — treated as a single column
diagnostic.COLUMN_SPARSE_DROPPED: Column candidate (index {index}) covered only {percent}% of block height (< {minPercent}%) — removed from the reading-order column list (may be a sidebar, not a column); its lines went to the nearest remaining column
diagnostic.COLUMN_COUNT_UNSTABLE: Page {pageNumber}: detected {columnCount} column(s), neighboring pages have {neighborCounts} — possible detection error, consistency not enforced
diagnostic.IMAGE_DECODE_EMPTY: objId={objId} ({source}): object resolved to null/undefined — likely a failed decode (e.g. missing wasmUrl for JPX)
diagnostic.UNUSUAL_TEXT_ANGLE: Unusual text angle {angle}° (not a multiple of 90°) — assigned to nearest bucket {bucket}°
diagnostic.INLINE_HEADING_EDGE_SPLIT: {count} line(s) with an inline mid-paragraph heading label (prefix/suffix) split
diagnostic.GUTTER_FALSE_MERGE_REPAIRED: {count} line(s) falsely merged across columns at the same height, split (column confidence={confidence})
diagnostic.IMAGE_CLUSTER_AREA_OVERREACH: Cluster ({imageCount} images) covers {percent}% of the page — forced to 'undecided' instead of '{classification}'
diagnostic.IMAGE_EXTREME_ASPECT_RATIO_UNDECIDED: Image with extreme proportions (≥{threshold}:1) — could be a decorative strip, but could also be a map or a full-column illustration. Check the Images tab.
diagnostic.IMAGE_TOO_SMALL_UNDECIDED: Image {width}×{height}px, below {threshold}px — could be too small to be useful, but could also be a genuine small icon/portrait. Check the Images tab.
diagnostic.REVIEW_JOURNAL_IMAGE_MISSING: Missing image bytes {imageId} embedded in a journal
diagnostic.PLAYER_CHARACTER_ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED: Page skipped: recognized as a player character, but the profile has no patterns for this route yet

coc7.CHARACTERISTIC_NOT_NUMERIC: {label}: value "{raw}" is not a number — skipped (likely "–" = this creature doesn't have this characteristic)
coc7.HIT_POINTS_MISSING: No hit points found in the source — needs manual completion.
coc7.HIT_POINTS_ASTERISK: HP: source value "{raw}" carries a footnote (*) — check the book's text for what it means in this specific case before trusting the number.
coc7.HIT_POINTS_UNPARSEABLE: HP: value "{raw}" is not a number — skipped (likely "–" = this creature doesn't have this characteristic).
coc7.MAGIC_POINTS_UNPARSEABLE: Magic points: value "{raw}" is not a number — skipped.
coc7.MAGIC_POINTS_FOOTNOTE: Magic points: source value "{raw}" carries a footnote reference (*) — check the book's text before trusting the number.
coc7.SANITY_UNPARSEABLE: Sanity: value "{raw}" is not a number — skipped.
coc7.MOVEMENT_UNPARSEABLE: Movement: source value "{raw}" isn't a plain number (e.g. a flying creature with two values) — skipped, needs manual completion.
coc7.MOVEMENT_RATIO_VARIANT: Movement: source gives "{raw}" — the base value {base} went on the sheet. The {alternate} variant{footnoteNote} was not lost, but needs manual handling wherever it applies.
coc7.BUILD_UNPARSEABLE: Build: value "{raw}" is not a number — skipped.
coc7.DAMAGE_BONUS_UNPARSEABLE: Damage bonus (DB): value "{raw}" doesn't look like a number or dice — skipped, needs manual completion.
coc7.LUCK_NOT_RECOGNIZED: Luck isn't recognized by this profile — needs manual completion.
coc7.LUCK_UNPARSEABLE: Luck: value "{raw}" is not a number — skipped.
coc7.ARMOR_UNPARSEABLE: Armor: value "{raw}" is not a number — skipped, needs manual completion.
coc7.ARMOR_DESCRIPTION: Armor: description found after the value in the source — "{raw}".
coc7.NO_ATTACKS_SECTION: No ATTACKS section found in the source — if this isn't a civilian without an attack, check manually.
coc7.ATTACK_LINKED_TO_PREVIOUS_SKILL: Attack "{attackName}": no hit chance of its own — treated as a maneuver variant, linked to skill "{linkedSkillName}" (the nearest earlier attack in the source). Check whether this link is correct.
coc7.ATTACK_NO_TOHIT_NO_PREVIOUS: Attack "{attackName}": no hit chance of its own and no earlier attack to link to — created as its own 0% skill, needs manual correction.
coc7.WEAPON_DAMAGE_UNRECOGNIZED: Weapon "{attackName}": damage wasn't recognized automatically — needs manual completion.
coc7.WEAPON_AMMO_CAPACITY_UNKNOWN: Ranged weapon "{attackName}": the source doesn't state magazine capacity — the "Magazine" field on this weapon's card was left empty. The reload button on the Actor sheet won't do anything until you enter the real capacity there by hand.
coc7.UNCERTAIN_NAME: Uncertain name (placeholder): "{name}" — resolve manually before use.
coc7.ACTOR_TOKEN_IMAGE_NOT_UPLOADED: Token image wasn't uploaded (unchecked in the Images tab, or the upload failed) — created without a token image.
coc7.ACTOR_PORTRAIT_IMAGE_NOT_UPLOADED: Portrait image wasn't uploaded (unchecked in the Images tab, or the upload failed) — created without a portrait.
coc7.attackBelowTextLabel: From the text below the attacks section:
